title: 02. Ingestion & Chunking: Metadata Extraction and Storage
summary: Metadata is the structured information about a document that enables filtering, faceting, access control, and hybrid search in a vector database.

sections.title: ① Concept Explanation
sections.body: Metadata is the structured information about a document that enables filtering, faceting, access control, and hybrid search in a vector database. Without rich metadata, a vector database can only do semantic similarity search — with metadata, you can filter by date range, document type, author, department, access role, or language before or after semantic search. In production RAG, metadata is the difference between a system that returns any semantically similar document and one that returns the right document for the right user at the right time.

sections.title: ② Key Code
sections.body:
```python
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Optional, List
import hashlib

class DocumentMetadata(BaseModel):
    """Production-grade document metadata schema."""
    
    # Identity
    doc_id: str = Field(..., description="Unique document identifier")
    chunk_id: str = Field(..., description="Unique chunk identifier")
    
    # Source
    source: str = Field(..., description="File path or URL")
    file_name: str
    doc_type: str  # "pdf", "docx", "html", "csv"
    
    # Structure
    page: Optional[int] = None
    section: Optional[str] = None
    heading_h1: Optional[str] = None
    heading_h2: Optional[str] = None
    
    # Temporal
    created_at: Optional[str] = None
    updated_at: Optional[str] = None
    content_hash: str
    
    # Content
    char_count: int
    language: Optional[str] = "en"
    
    # Access control
    access_roles: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    department: Optional[str] = None
    classification: str = "internal"  # "public", "internal", "confidential"
    
    # Quality
    ocr_quality: Optional[float] = None
    is_duplicate: bool = False

# Auto-extract metadata using LLM
async def extract_metadata_with_llm(text: str, llm) -> dict:
    """Use LLM to extract structured metadata from document text."""
    from langchain_core.prompts import ChatPromptTemplate
    
    prompt = ChatPromptTemplate.from_template("""
Extract structured metadata from this document excerpt.

Document text (first 1000 chars):
{text}

Extract and return JSON with these fields:
- title: document title if visible
- author: author name if visible
- date: document date if visible (ISO format)
- department: department or team name if visible
- document_type: contract/policy/report/manual/other
- language: ISO 639-1 language code
- topics: list of up to 5 main topics

Return ONLY valid JSON, no explanation.""")
    
    structured_llm = llm.with_structured_output(dict)
    chain = prompt | structured_llm
    
    try:
        metadata = await chain.ainvoke({"text": text[:1000]})
        return metadata
    except Exception:
        return {}  # Fallback gracefully

# Storing metadata in Qdrant
from qdrant_client import QdrantClient
from qdrant_client.models import Filter, FieldCondition, MatchValue, DatetimeRange

def query_with_metadata_filter(
    qdrant: QdrantClient,
    query_vector: list[float],
    department: str,
    access_role: str,
    after_date: str,
    top_k: int = 5
):
    """Retrieve only documents matching metadata criteria."""
    from qdrant_client.models import Filter, FieldCondition, MatchValue, MatchAny
    
    results = qdrant.search(
        collection_name="rag_docs",
        query_vector=query_vector,
        limit=top_k,
        query_filter=Filter(
            must=[
                FieldCondition(key="department", match=MatchValue(value=department)),
                FieldCondition(key="access_roles", match=MatchAny(any=[access_role, "all"])),
            ]
        )
    )
    return results
```
